note: Not built; no step existed (grep of roadmap steps and page copy, 18:32 CST). What exists: five closed 'taken-*' items (for example 'Taken for you, against your typed B ... Overrule?'), each one card in Answered, and no area that gathers them. Design first (designer, mockup per size and theme), then test-author, builder, reviewer. Open for the designer: which items it lists (taken picks, closed with a taken flag), order newest first with last 24 hours and older (step page-artifacts-section-newest-first), and one Overrule button per card. Prior-work search first: step stood-pick-closes-on-answer. Owner 18:49 CST Nov 18: it existed before; MECHANIZE it. Prior work: a 'Pick stands' section (stands:true items, 41 in outbox pick-stands-audit.md); steps pick-reaches-page (doing, lane session_013NEJL1J8PbpBBHCYyXXDSM) and stood-pick-closes-on-answer; the owner's Nov 15 ruling (step page-no-preselected-pick) removed the stands fields, so the section vanished. Mechanize: an export check fails when taken picks exist and the area does not render; extend pick-reaches-page for the send check.
